svg.title: Wizard Duel character design
svg.desc: Character reference, palettes, turnarounds, costume details, and production specifications for Berik and Alisher.
svg.text: Retro pixel art character bible • production proportions • turnarounds • costume callouts • export rules
Must read at 1× size without VFX
Must read at 1× size without VFX
Widest horizontal shape; never reduce below head width ×2.3.
Brightest non-VFX value. Keeps face readable on dark arena.
Single gold vertical line guides eye toward casting hand.
Asymmetric left-side mass creates motion even during idle.
Tall triangular read separates him from Berik instantly.
Keep facial detail minimal; only eye/skin hint at close range.
Anchors the torso and prevents robe from becoming one red mass.
Long angular sleeves should exaggerate aggressive casting poses.
48 × 76 px character body inside 64 × 96 transparent frame
bottom-center at feet: (32, 90) in 64×96 source frame
right hand socket approx. (47, 37); VFX attaches here
torso rectangle only; hat / robe tails should not enlarge hurtbox
must remain identifiable at 100% browser zoom on 1366×768
1 px dark separation only where values merge; no universal black outline
none; movement snaps visually to integer pixels when animation settles
BERIK animation personality: 2–3 frame anticipation, clean follow-through, stable feet.
48 × 76 px character body inside 64 × 96 transparent frame
bottom-center at feet: (32, 90) in 64×96 source frame
right hand socket approx. (48, 36); fire VFX attaches here
torso rectangle only; hood / robe tails are visual-only
must remain identifiable at 100% browser zoom on 1366×768
deep maroon separation; reserve true black for face shadow only
none; dash smear can use extra ghost sprites, not blurred transforms
ALISHER animation personality: sharper anticipation, faster release, longer cloth overshoot.
